records.key: The conversion ledger references an unplanned source file; use a new destination.
records.source: The conversion ledger references an unplanned source file; use a new destination.
records.translation: O registro de conversão faz referência a um arquivo de origem não planejado; use um novo destino.

records.key: The converted crop index contains duplicate object_id values; retain originals.
records.source: The converted crop index contains duplicate object_id values; retain originals.
records.translation: O índice de recortes convertido contém valores object_id duplicados; mantenha os originais.

records.key: The crop label is absent from its object measurement table; restore matching source records.
records.source: The crop label is absent from its object measurement table; restore matching source records.
records.translation: O rótulo do recorte está ausente da tabela de medições do objeto; restaure os registros de origem correspondentes.

records.key: The object measurement table has ambiguous labels or duplicate identities; resolve it before conversion.
records.source: The object measurement table has ambiguous labels or duplicate identities; resolve it before conversion.
records.translation: A tabela de medições de objetos tem rótulos ambíguos ou identidades duplicadas; resolva-a antes da conversão.

records.key: The shared crop cutter did not return the requested object; retain the original project.
records.source: The shared crop cutter did not return the requested object; retain the original project.
records.translation: O extrator compartilhado de recortes não retornou o objeto solicitado; mantenha o projeto original.

records.key: The shared crop reader cannot resolve this exact source row; restore its original role and label.
records.source: The shared crop reader cannot resolve this exact source row; restore its original role and label.
records.translation: O leitor compartilhado de recortes não consegue resolver esta linha exata de origem; restaure sua função e seu rótulo originais.

records.key: This project already has a crop-store index; use its existing store instead of replacing its locators.
records.source: This project already has a crop-store index; use its existing store instead of replacing its locators.
records.translation: Este projeto já tem um índice de armazenamento de recortes; use o armazenamento existente em vez de substituir seus localizadores.

records.key: This source already has a conversion ledger; use the original legacy project.
records.source: This source already has a conversion ledger; use the original legacy project.
records.translation: Esta origem já tem um registro de conversão; use o projeto legado original.

records.key: Timed crop identities require a time-aware field store; retain this project until that shared API is available.
records.source: Timed crop identities require a time-aware field store; retain this project until that shared API is available.
records.translation: Identidades de recortes com informação temporal requerem um armazenamento de campos com suporte temporal; mantenha este projeto até que essa API compartilhada esteja disponível.

records.key: Uncommitted crop output already exists outside staging; choose a clean destination.
records.source: Uncommitted crop output already exists outside staging; choose a clean destination.
records.translation: Já existe saída de recortes não confirmada fora da área de preparação; escolha um destino limpo.

records.key: Unconverted crops still depend on the legacy project; keep source images and masks.
records.source: Unconverted crops still depend on the legacy project; keep source images and masks.
records.translation: Os recortes não convertidos ainda dependem do projeto legado; mantenha as imagens e máscaras de origem.
